scope: Two independent native bodies with controlled engine/event/ability/counter/mana/stack/GUI callbacks. Native switch table retained read-only with all eleven entries checked inside get_abilities. Cdecl entries; engine function-pointer literals and direct engine calls are explicitly rebound. Memcpy is observed without mutations and performs the complete 300-byte copy. Trace records use hashes for compound state/arguments; full declared fixture outputs are byte compared. Allocated 6-slot banks, acyclic activation parents, bounded stack/type indices and strings, nonoverlapping legacy/source records, and initialized packed counter storage are required. A controlled allocated type-table prefix models raw -1 result reads under the target 32-bit compiler behavior; no portable abstract-C or whole-engine memory claim. Two further functions change only exact source/expanded local identifier projections and claim no new native cases.
